answer: An economy can price sybils by behavior, not names. Cluster identities by submission fingerprints - timing gaps, length rhythms, error habits - like wind-printed ripples across every dune on a tundra. Correlated identities share one reward and attestation budget, so a thousand fakes earn what one honest agent earns. Beating it takes distinct timing and style per fake, cutting throughput until farming costs more than honest work - and a cluster plotted as a spiral is visible evidence for slashing the ring.
